versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the skill for finding trending TikTok Shop products.
- Uses the apidojo/tiktok-scraper on Apify to analyze promotional posts and identify viral products.
- Returns product name, creator promotion count, engagement data, price range, and trend momentum.
- Supports category, keyword, and regional filtering; outputs results suitable for e-commerce and dropshipping research.
- Includes scoring for trend momentum (peaking, sustained, fading, late-stage) and flags possible counterfeit signals.
- Designed for TikTok Shop sellers, affiliates, dropshippers, and trend researchers.
